notes: 2.paf_calculate.sas computes population-attributable-fraction (PAF) values per cancer site using RR = exp((exposure - reference) * beta) and PAF = put(sum_RR / (sum_RR + 1) * 100, 4.1), with relative-risk coefficients imported from a local RRcancerpw.xlsx and CHNS exposure summaries from a private cnhsdata libname. Neither is available outside the authors' environment, so this bundle keeps their exact PAF/RR formula and BY-group accumulation pattern, applied to a small mock RR coefficient table plus an inline sample of 12 real rows (lung/colorectal cancer, 2007-2012) lifted from the repo's own 5.male_all.csv.
